contract.purpose: Open Historia helps strategy players explore a persistent campaign through natural-language orders, diplomacy and an interactive map.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Open Historia explores a local AI grand-strategy game where countries remember history and carry it into future turns.
contract.driftNote: The held lifecycle is preserved; responsive repair does not establish historical or cloud-save qualification.
contract.audience: Strategy players interested in emergent historical storytelling without metered model credits.
contract.job: Inspect the map, queue an order, advance time, read consequences and save the campaign on a small screen.
contract.thesis: Preserve the dark cartographic terminal, but assign each panel its own space when overlays cannot fit.
contract.system: Existing slate panels and mono controls; amber actions, emerald saves, teal advisor. Wrapping toolbar and vertical flow below 1100px; existing map overlays above.
contract.signature: The country map stays adjacent to the order terminal; generated consequences lead into story and diplomatic history.
contract.risk: A vertical campaign needs scrolling to secondary tools. This preserves every tool and removes overlap without adding a new tab navigation system.

projectCheck.command: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm exec playwright test e2e/campaign-layout.spec.ts e2e/campaign.spec.ts --project=desktop --project=mobile

ownerFeedback.note: Owner authorized sequential repairs and shipping; preserve lane selected from the existing campaign UI.
